verdict.rationale: Evidence shows webhooks that fire on 'status changes' and general workflow automation (SLAs, discounts), which could be used to build customer notifications, but there is no explicit documentation confirming a built-in feature that automatically emails/notifies the customers who requested a feature when its status changes. missing for 10: explicit docs on automatic voter/customer notification upon status change, in-app or email confirmation of this specific workflow, and independent corroboration.
